tools.name: service_info
tools.description: Get the Qdrant instance title, version and build commit from the service root endpoint

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the names of every collection on the Qdrant instance

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get one Qdrant collection's status, point counts and vector configuration by name

collection.description: Collection name as returned by list_collections

tools.name: list_aliases
tools.description: List every collection alias on the Qdrant instance with the collection each one points at

tools.name: cluster_info
tools.description: Get Qdrant cluster status: whether distributed mode is enabled, this peer's id, its peers and its raft state

tools.name: telemetry
tools.description: Get Qdrant instance telemetry: app name and version, collection count and cluster mode

anonymize.description: Ask Qdrant to anonymize identifiers in the telemetry payload

needs_review: The vault marks api_key optional (a Qdrant started without QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY needs no key), but this spec keeps it in requiredFields as scaffolded: the api-key header template cannot render without it. An unauthenticated instance therefore needs a value stored anyway, or the spec needs an auth.type of none. Unresolved blind

Qdrant is customer-hosted, so base_url comes from the host credential and no path is provable against a vendor-run endpoint. Every tool here is GET-only and the whole spec is unproven until the live harness runs it against a real ephemeral container

telemetry's payload shape is version-dependent (details_level, the collections/cluster sub-objects and the requests block have all moved across 1.x releases). Only the fields documented at the default detail level are picked, and the documented details_level query param is deliberately NOT exposed so an older instance cannot be sent a parameter it does not know

cluster_info answers 200 with result.status 'disabled' on a single-node instance, so the raft_* picks resolve to nothing there rather than failing. That is the expected fresh-instance result, not an error

No list endpoint in the Qdrant REST surface takes a limit, so no clamp helper appears in this spec. Point reads (scroll, count) are POST bodies and are not wired here; get_collection already carries points_count
The _probe collection name is quoxproof-live, which the live provisioner creates. On an instance without it, get_collection answers 404
